feature: Goal steers and distinct child chat surfaces

cases.title: BTW returns to main with an unsent draft using mouse or leader shortcut
preconditions: BTW composer focused with a draft
stimulus: click Back to main or press leader followed by up

oracles.expected: main transcript replaces BTW and draft remains available

negative: navigation does not submit or discard the draft
determinism: fixed HTTP fixtures and input events; wait for rendered parent identity

cases.title: goal steer renders generated text with synthetic provenance

oracles.expected: Goal · steer block shows generated text

negative: generic description does not replace generated text

cases.title: child todos hydrate and update while the parent rail stays hidden
preconditions: child has completed, active and pending todos

oracles.expected: all tasks and current markers render; open count reaches zero

negative: ordinary child gains no conversation composer
determinism: fixed fixtures; wait for event subscription and rendered predicate

cases.title: BTW chat distinguishes snapshot context from delegated work at narrow and wide widths
preconditions: BTW child and immediate parent hydrated

oracles.expected: BTW identity, read-only snapshot context, back navigation and export hint render with one composer
opening side chat sends no prompt

negative: no subagent count, sibling navigation, economics or picker
